title: Speech AI Agent
description: A real-time voice assistant powered by Amazon Nova Sonic 2.
fulldescription: This prototype launches a voice-enabled AI assistant capable of real-time speech-to-speech interaction. It uses Amazon EC2 to host a lightweight WebSocket server that streams audio directly to Amazon Bedrock. The AI model used is Amazon Nova Sonic 2, which is optimized for low-latency speech processing. Amazon CloudFront provides a secure, HTTPS-enabled frontend interface, while Amazon S3 stores the web application files. This setup demonstrates how to build responsive voice interfaces without managing complex audio processing pipelines.

services.name: Amazon EC2
services.desc: Hosts the real-time WebSocket server for audio streaming.

services.name: Amazon Bedrock
services.desc: Runs the Nova Sonic 2 model for speech-to-speech inference.

services.name: Amazon CloudFront
services.desc: Delivers the secure web interface to your browser.

services.name: S3
